theme_strategy: Light Theme Priority (Nature/Organic/Soft/Pastel focus). Dark theme is NOT recommended to preserve the delicate pink/lilac aesthetics.

font_pairings.classes: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif text-[#2D2424] tracking-tight leading-none

visual_enhancers.radii: Rounded corners for friendly feel: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards; rounded-full for buttons
visual_enhancers.gradients: Discreet, soft watercolor-like gradients (e.g., bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FDF2F2] to-[#E6E6FA])
visual_enhancers.shapes: Organic blob shapes in the background, soft watercolor textures, no sharp edges

layouts_and_grids.container: Max-width 7xl with generous padding px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24

sections.gallery: Bento grid or masonry layout for product showcase

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Fade-in on scroll using Framer Motion (initial {{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }})
motion_and_interactions.hover: Soft card lift (-translate-y-2) and subtle shadow increase
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Micro-scale on click (scale: 0.95), subtle shine effect on gold/primary buttons
motion_and_interactions.navbar: Glassmorphism default (bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-md), transitions to bg-white/90 shadow-sm on scroll

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons should use pastel pink or soft gold with dark text. WhatsApp buttons use #25D366 or soft green.
component_instructions.cards: Cardless or flat white cards with rounded-3xl and very soft pink/lilac shadow. No heavy borders.
component_instructions.navbar: Sticky, glassmorphism. Avoid fully transparent background if text overlaps content.
component_instructions.icons: Use Lucide-React for clean, delicate line icons (strokeWidth={1.5}).

media_and_images.art_direction: Use realistic photos for actual products (baskets, charcuterie). Use SVG illustrations for the grandmother mascot, watercolor blobs, and small decorative details (ribbons, hearts, sparkles).

accessibility: Ensure text contrast on pastel backgrounds. Use text-[#2D2424] or #4A3B39 for readability. Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NOTE: Codebase uses .js extension, not .tsx. Output pure React JS.
Prioritize UI elegance and whitespace. Do not cram elements.
Add transition-all carefully, prefer targeted transitions (transform, opacity).
Avoid generic centered layouts except for specific CTA sections.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs).
Use Framer Motion for scroll animations (initial/whileInView).
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use dark brown/grey #2D2424.
Do NOT use transparent headers that obscure content. Always use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent color.
Embrace asymmetry and breathing room. Let the pastel colors speak softly.
